contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Parse text using typed-decimal semantics: drop all ECMAScript whitespace, change the first comma to a dot only when no dot exists, and accept only signed plain decimal notation without exponent or suffix. On failure use fallback. Then clamp either result between lower and upper.
contract.domain: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. Text is at most 20 characters and any accepted value is finite. Numeric arguments are finite from -1000 through 1000; lower <= upper.
contract.outputRole: parsed or fallback number clamped to bounds
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.

documentation: Native semantics reviewed against VeraCompiler.ets and VeraUi.ets. These tasks are not translated upstream symbols.
